## About
Spine Authority Chiropractic & Wellness is a chiropractic office on Bissonnet St in Houston. Dr. Mena and her team see people dealing with sprains and strains, headaches, plantar fasciitis, sciatica, bursitis, neck pain and low back pain, along with injuries from work, car accidents and everyday life.
We customize every examination and treatment to the person in front of us. That might mean spinal manipulation, electrical muscle stimulation, ultrasound therapy, rehabilitative exercises or spinal decompression therapy, depending on what your body needs.
Our patients have given us a 5 rating across 155 Google reviews. One reviewer said Dr. Mena takes time to listen, another said she explains her concerns and treatment options, and one came to us after a motor vehicle accident.

## Services
- Spinal manipulation: Hands-on chiropractic adjustments, tailored to your exam.
- Spinal decompression therapy: Decompression therapy as part of a customized treatment plan.
- Electrical muscle stimulation: Muscle stimulation offered alongside other therapies.
- Ultrasound therapy: Ultrasound therapy as one of the tools in your care.
- Rehabilitative exercises: Exercises to help you rebuild strength and motion.
- Auto injury care: Treatment for injuries from car accidents.
- Work injury care: Care for injuries that build up from work stress and repetitive activities.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 7 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you treat injuries from car accidents?
A: Yes. Auto injuries are one of the things we treat, and one reviewer came to us after a motor vehicle accident.

Q: Will my treatment be the same as everyone else's?
A: No. Our examinations and treatments are customized to each patient's needs.
